recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source change is needed for FHIR-31710 unless a future work group decision chooses to change the Bluebook vitamin K questions themselves from dateTime to date.
issue_request: FHIR-31710 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the Bluebook Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse examples. It reported mismatched sex code capitalization, vitamin K dose linkIds, vitamin K dose answer value types, and requested the QuestionnaireResponse example to reference its Questionnaire so validation could catch these mismatches.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit b14ef4539d52882fe70340160e296928ff6ba56b, "FHIR-31710 - Fixed alignment of bluebook examples", which changed the Questionnaire vitamin K dose linkIds from vitaminiK* to vitaminK*, replaced the QuestionnaireResponse display-only questionnaire element with the canonical Questionnaire URL, and changed the vitamin K dose answers from valueDate to valueDateTime. Later edits to these files were metadata, formatting, list, and invariant-test updates and did not reintroduce the reported mismatches.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and the Bluebook examples remain listed in the current example lists. Confluence minutes record the issue as Persuasive, and bounded Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion beyond the meeting/vote records. The Questionnaire still uses dateTime for the vitamin K dose questions, and the response now uses matching valueDateTime answers with valid date-only lexical values.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has the QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire canonical reference, uppercase sex code F, matching vitaminK dose linkIds, and valueDateTime answers matching the Questionnaire's dateTime item types.
